cost_reduction_strategies.description: Deploy autonomous trucks and drilling systems
Replace diesel generation with solar PV plus battery storage hybrid systems
Implement advanced process control and real-time optimization in processing plants
Use geostatistics and machine learning to optimize blast patterns and selective mining
Optimize truck fleet size and dispatch using mine-to-mill integration
Implement closed-loop water systems to reduce freshwater intake and costs
Upgrade to high-efficiency motors, VFDs, and optimize compressed air systems
Deploy IoT sensors and AI-based predictive maintenance to reduce unplanned downtime
Replace conventional mining with in-situ leaching where geology permits
Reprocess historical tailings dumps with modern extraction technology
Integrate blasting, crushing, and grinding to maximize mill throughput
Long-term power purchase agreements with renewable energy providers
